verdict.rationale: TrueLayer's Data API documents reading account information, balances and transaction history from a user's connected bank through a single interface. That covers the core of pulling transactions via the API. The evidence is only brief summary-level mentions, with nothing on how pagination, history depth or incremental sync work. missing for 10: documented pagination, documented history depth/lookback window, a sync or delta pattern for fetching only changed transactions, in-depth endpoint reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.
